subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: After the duplicate parser modules are removed and the branch is refreshed, should OpenClaw adopt this env-gated grouped Claw schema and read-only planner as the base of the open RFC implementation stack?
rationale: Technical cleanup cannot decide whether OpenClaw should establish the new manifest, CLI, ownership, and versioned output contracts while the governing RFC remains unaccepted.

options.title: Repair, accept RFC, then land
options.body: Remove the duplicate parsers, refresh against main, accept the durable RFC contract, and then merge this first implementation slice.

options.title: Permit pre-acceptance experimentation
options.body: Explicitly sponsor the env-gated implementation before RFC acceptance while treating all exposed contracts as disposable.

options.title: Pause the implementation stack
options.body: Keep this and the dependent draft PRs open without landing until the RFC scope and lifecycle contracts are narrowed or accepted.

recommendation.title: Repair, accept RFC, then land
recommendation.body: Remove the duplicate parsers, refresh against main, accept the durable RFC contract, and then merge this first implementation slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review supplied the concrete product-model boundaries adopted by both the RFC and this implementation.
